interpretation_limits: Squares is fitted development data; success there is not transfer validation.
Fibonacci and strict_16 are archival controls, not prospective held-out cases.
A nonnegative corrected score is a sufficient whole-component certificate; a negative score is only inconclusive.
All currently tied pair-label instances have one component, so multi-component aggregation remains untested unless the pinned data contradict this.
A failed local certificate is not failed loneliness; isolated equality is not positive duration.
Selected-reference findings do not imply whole-configuration claims.
No new existence coverage, general selector, runtime, literature or novelty claim is authorized.
AI agreement is not independent mathematical validation.
